scenarios.assumption: Projection requested by the operator on 2026-10-19: the statement as if ADM-158 were done. Starting point: the ERP as it stands (no lane override, so 45528's S.1 line is back in 1B; the R-1,776.24 gas credit is not held aside). The ERP then posts a credit note for 45528's S.1 x5 (R-6,037.50, 1B) and an invoice for 5 x 48kg gas (R+7,267.54, 1A, at the July / 7 Aug 2025 price; ASSUMED, the ERP sets the price). Writing the R1,776.24 credit off against the R1,230.04 shortfall is an allocation, not a new document, so it does not move any balance: the gas lane simply nets the new invoice against the credit, leaving R546.20 of credit for the operator to decide. Projected posting date 19 Oct 2026 (ASSUMED).
scenarios.notes: At the 25 Aug 2025 price (R7,124.02) the projected gas invoice, the shortfall and the closing 1A and combined balances would all be R143.52 lower, and the remaining credit R689.72.
